questions.q: Do you like listening to music?
questions.answer: I do, it's part of my daily life really. I listen while I work, travel and relax. My taste is fairly [[eclectic]], from mellow acoustic tracks to a bit of classical when I need to concentrate.

questions.q: What kind of music is popular in your country?
questions.answer: Traditional folk music is still hugely popular, especially Baul songs and the classics of Tagore and Nazrul. Younger people also love modern Bangla bands and Western pop, so there's a fascinating [[fusion]] of old and new.

questions.q: Can you play a musical instrument?
questions.answer: Not properly, unfortunately. I dabbled with the guitar as a teenager but never [[persevered]]. It's one of those things I'd genuinely love to return to one day, when I finally have the time.
I enjoy it, though only in private or among close friends. I wouldn't sing in front of a crowd, but humming along to a favourite song is one of life's simple [[pleasures]].

questions.q: Do you think children should learn music at school?
questions.answer: I really think they should. Learning an instrument teaches discipline and patience, and it gives children a [[creative outlet]] that other subjects don't always offer. I sometimes wish I'd had more encouragement myself when I was younger.
